topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
consensus_response: The 11.6% bandwidth limitation of the CTS antenna restricts available frequency resources, increasing interference susceptibility and reducing system capacity. Adaptive channel allocation and beamforming techniques can mitigate these effects, optimizing resource usage and maximizing traffic accommodation rates.
reference_context: SatCom systems require careful frequency planning due to limited bandwidth, affecting spectral efficiency and capacity.
